authorization: A design/archive review only; candidate scoring waits for main structural review

public.time_unit: Wan VAE normalized latent regular window; nominal stride4 RGB, not one RGB frame

state.component_permutation: sort j=0..7 by (SHA256(VTOS1/state/order NUL key NUL decimal_j),j)
state.spatial_interpretation: two-component partition plus global parity constraints; not four independent full-state replicas
state.outside_source: s_t=0 for t<1 only in composite boundary templates; t>45 unsupported, never cyclic

basis.domain: actual real normalized latent spatial tensor; no FFT target
basis.column_order: sort c=0..15 by (SHA256(VTOS1/basis/order NUL key NUL decimal_i NUL decimal_c),c)
basis.column_sign: 2*(SHA256(VTOS1/basis/sign NUL key NUL decimal_i NUL decimal_q)[0]&1)-1
basis.hash_encoding: UTF-8 NUL-separated fields, decimal unsigned integers, no trailing NUL

tubes.support: tube(t,i) adds on physical u=t+a only while u<=45, same public spatial block i
tubes.active_groups: at u: a=0..min(3,u-1); tube start t=u-a
tubes.temporal_replicas_per_state: min(4,46-t); no tail padding or cyclic extension
tubes.physical_tube_index_relation: With tube I=(start a, spatial block i), age r: h_(a+r),I=alpha*sum_k U_i,r,k*s_a[2*i+k]; net physical state sums all active I
tubes.clock_inference_relation: x_u=[s_u,s_(u-1),s_(u-2),s_(u-3)] is a public augmented delayed-state template; match received composite coordinates to x_tau, not four independent observations of s_tau

synthesis.operation: scatter-add every tube into one actual full tensor, then extract from that tensor
synthesis.redundancy: each state component repeats over distinct age subspaces at up to four physical times; simultaneous age components mix at the same physical voxels

observation.interpretation: age lanes are simultaneous coordinates of one composite state, not observations at separate received times
observation.normalization: same public alpha from full45 source, including crop inputs

cpu.additive_write: Y=host+W; actual combined pilot delta W has L2=1 before attacks

future_C.payload: unchanged ch0..3 FFT-real masked mean loss and eta5520, computed fresh from conditional clean
future_C.pilot_loss: mean squared projected coefficient residual over1392 active orthonormal coefficients of the same real tensor
future_C.pilot_raw_eta_formula: 1392/8; separate basis-space loss, not old joint FFT mask_count
future_C.cap_rule: d_pilot=raw*min(1,1/||raw||_2); zero raw stays zero; never upscale
future_C.merge: sum actual full tensors d_payload+d_pilot before conditional Flow velocity correction and FP32 CFG5
future_C.total_norm: measure actual merged norm/RMS and cross term; disjoint channels imply norm_squared=payload_norm_squared+pilot_norm_squared up to numerical precision
future_C.overlap_cross_terms: verify actual basis Gram and merged tensor; do not reuse old hardcoded cross-inner-product report

future_payload.reserved_basis_columns: q8..15 only, no current energy allocation or writing
future_payload.interface: decode_blocks(saved_received_features, previously_frozen_state_path, public_key) -> bits/erasures/checks; truth joins afterward
future_payload.checksum: reserved CRC-8 poly0x07 init0 xorout0 unreflected over public tau byte,block_id byte,payload bytes; not used to choose this state path
controls: wrong fixed tau+1 without wrap; out-of-source=erasure
future_payload.old_repeated_32bit_payload: retained for future frontend reference; cannot establish synchronization necessity

stage_B_plan.edit_roster: NO_EDIT; DELETE at p=2,floor((L+1)/2),L-1; REPEAT after each same p; mutate shared tensor before projection
stage_B_plan.noise_meaning: ideal full-spatial-tensor additive Gaussian mechanism noise, not real latent host/VAE background
missing: public block0 absent for entire received clip
received regular j16 unavailable, index slot retained
stage_B_plan.condition_formula: 4 clips*7 edits*5 noise cases*3 missing cases*2 writer controls*2 keys
stage_B_plan.unknown_insert: not a supported repeat operator; exact-copy insertion vs repeat is an indistinguishable-label counterexample
stage_B_plan.zero_watermark_insert: separate fixed null-row interface/counterexample; not a free wildcard emission and not part of primary path family
stage_B_plan.interpolation: separate midpoint(0.5*adjacent physical tensors) counterexample; not relabeled repeat or arbitrary insert
stage_B_plan.counterexample_roster: for each of4 clips at middle p: exact-copy insert,zero-watermark insert,midpoint insert; correct/wrong keys;24 records, noiseless/no missing
stage_B_plan.unsupported_family_handling: raw finite-family fits may be reported, but attack family is posthoc only and never supplies an insertion label to the receiver; do not claim arbitrary insert identifiability

stage_C.gate: Only after CPU structural review; user-run notebook candidate and static/CPU adapter only
stage_C.native_history: 50 complete steps, FP32 conditional control/CFG, no reset
stage_C.media: whole saved RGB video -> matched second-codec full/crop/edit -> readback -> complete-frame VAE mode normalization -> ROI projection
limitations: current fixed-phase model does not cover phase-changing single-RGB edits
crop VAE reset is not full-latent slicing
no local image ROI VAE shortcut

scoring.emission: sum over available i,age,k of (r[j,i,age,k]-alpha*s_(tau_j-age)[2*i+k])^2; boundary state below1 is0 and remains counted
scoring.path_cost: total available squared residual / M, where M=8*sum_(j,i)availability[j,i]; same M for all candidates in one condition
scoring.tie_rule: global cost-min_cost<=1e-12 absolute; retain all structural and numerical ties
scoring.equivalence_signature: exact integer tuple of s_(tau_j-age)[2*i+k] or boundary0 in received j,i,age,k order, using ONLY available coordinates; alpha is common and positive
scoring.equivalence_computation: group exact signatures before numerical ranking; score each identical-template class once; do not exploit floating synthesis roundoff to split ideal-equal templates
scoring.missing_mask_shape: received_length by4 spatial blocks; false removes all8 age/component coordinates for that observed (j,i), but retains index j and candidate tau_j
scoring.zero_energy: if all available projected r squared sum is exactly0, retain finite costs/top cost ties for audit but status NO_ENERGY and canonical_path=None; no accepted path
scoring.all_missing: M=0: INCOMPLETE/NO_OBSERVATIONS, valid candidate costs=None, retained empty-signature equivalence class and all structural exclusions, canonical_path=None
scoring.nonfinite: nonfinite available ROI/projection/reduction -> INCOMPLETE/INVALID_OBSERVATION, no ranked path; unavailable coordinates may be absent and are not evaluated
scoring.unique_minimum_meaning: unique only in this finite public emission model; not confidence, real synchronization or detection acceptance
scoring.canonical_order: lexicographic complete tau sequence, then event type/index; representational only, never normal-advance preference
scoring.uncertainty: preserve all optimal class members, per-observed-index feasible tau sets and numerical top classes
